nuggets.text: The Bobcats are in their first Pac-12 season after 13 years in the Sun Belt.
The Bobcats' opener at Texas was their first meeting with the Longhorns since 1930.
The Bobcats are playing an all-Texas nonconference schedule for the first time since 1977.
G.J. Kinne's pro playing career ran through the NFL, UFL, Arena Football League and CFL.
The Bobcats have won three straight bowl games, the latest a 41-10 Armed Forces Bowl win over Rice.
Lyndon B. Johnson is a Texas State grad and the only US president to graduate from a Texas university.
Brad Jackson threw for 3,224 yards and ran for 17 TDs last season as a redshirt freshman.
Beau Sparks caught a 65-yard touchdown with 10 minutes left in the Bobcats' win at UTSA last year.
The Bobcats won NCAA Division II national championships in 1981 and 1982.
